# planetscale_neki_configuration_profile (Data Source)

NekiConfigurationProfile DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "planetscale_neki_configuration_profile" "my_nekiconfigurationprofile" {
  organization = "acme"
  database = "app"
  branch = "main"
  name = "default"
}

output "enabled_extensions" {
  value = data.planetscale_neki_configuration_profile.my_nekiconfigurationprofile.extensions
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `branch` (String) Branch name from `list_branches`. Example: `main`.
- `database` (String) Database name slug from `list_databases`. Example: `app-db`.
- `name` (String) The name of the shard configuration profile
- `organization` (String) Organization name slug from `list_organizations`. Example: `acme`.

### Optional

- `extensions` (List of String) Enabled extensions, excluding those required by PlanetScale.
- `parameters` (Map of Map of String) Managed effective parameter values nested by namespace. Remote non-default values are adopted during reads. Preload library parameters are only included when managed directly.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_size` (String) The name of the cluster size SKU
- `id` (String) The ID of the shard configuration profile
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default shard configuration profile
- `postgres_major_version` (Number) The PostgreSQL major version used by the shard configuration profile
- `postgres_minor_version` (Number) The PostgreSQL minor version used by the shard configuration profile
- `replicas` (Number) The number of replicas for shards using this configuration profile
- `shard_count` (Number) The number of shards using this configuration profile
- `state` (String) The current state of the shard configuration profile
- `storage` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage))

<a id="nestedatt--storage"></a>
### Nested Schema for `storage`

Read-Only:

- `maximum_storage_bytes` (Number) The maximum storage size in bytes for autoscaling
- `minimum_storage_bytes` (Number) The minimum storage size in bytes
- `storage_autoscaling` (Boolean) Whether storage autoscaling is enabled
- `storage_iops` (Number) The storage IOPS
- `storage_throughput_mibs` (Number) The storage throughput in MiB/s
